verdict.rationale: Link titles and body text were extracted from CIPO's public trademarks, patents and landing pages on ised-isde.canada.ca, which implies the guidance surface was served as readable HTML to an automated fetch. One page also notes that public patent search is available without an account alongside the MyCIPO login. However, no item explicitly documents fetch conditions such as user agent, absence of a bot wall or CAPTCHA, or server-side rendering versus a JS shell. missing for 10: explicit hands-on confirmation of a keyless fetch with an identified user agent, evidence of no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, confirmation that content is server-rendered rather than JS-only, coverage of deeper guidance pages beyond the three index pages.
